name: Kurenai Damashii
source:
Simon decides to spend time with Kamina and friends, but situation takes an unexpected turn resulting in different outcomes depending on decision taken.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
西蒙决定与卡米那和伙伴们一同度过一段时光，事态却朝着意想不到的方向发展。随着玩家做出的决定不同，故事也会迎来不同结局。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
